meta.title: evidence ledger
meta.description: Every DSH session transition lands in a hash-chained, append-only ledger in your own git repo.
meta.detail: A faithful port of the dsh-super-agent v1.5 ledger: entry_hash = sha256(kind⟟payload⟟prev). Edit a row and the chain breaks; truncate the tail and the head anchor breaks. Trust is a chain you can verify.
